sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: One-Way Ticket is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. Things have been going very well between us. That is why I would like to involve you in one... complicated task. My men attempted to pass through the Factory, but they were not allowed through. They all died. Now I must fill out a great deal of paperwork and request reinforcements... And we must also punish those responsible. I do not know exactly who was responsible for the deaths of my men, so engage everyone you encounter. And make your shots count, headshots only. I want the enemy to understand that this was not a coincidence."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 15 targets with headshots while using an AUG on Factory

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
- 1,100 Dollars
  - 1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Good work. Here is your reward."
